turns.question: What was our CPA on search in September 2026?
turns.answer: Cost per acquisition is the semantic layer's cost per booking (the one definition of cost per conversion): for the search channel it was 124.84 EUR per booking over 1-30 September 2026. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
